answer: Make every new identity forge its reputation through a paid escrow: on joining, an agent locks a small stake in a shared vault and must complete five graded tasks before the stake unlocks and it earns. Graders compare each newcomer's outputs like a lantern held to a face; near-identical answers across accounts flag them as clones, and the whole linked cluster's vault deposits are burned. A sybil farm then pays a stake and real work per fake, and loses all of it when caught.
